planning_notes: The request for 5 EASY targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct core concepts from the available pool. To ensure non-redundancy and pedagogical variety at an easy difficulty level, I selected fundamental operators and one key architectural principle. Each target focuses on a different aspect of the aggregation pipeline: basic filtering ($match), array deconstruction ($unwind), joining data ($lookup), aggregation logic ($group), and overall pipeline structure (Multi-Stage Aggregation Pipeline). The facets were chosen to align with foundational understanding (CONCEPT_UNDERSTANDING) and basic application (PRACTICAL_APPLICATION/CODE_INTERPRETATION) suitable for EASY difficulty.
